replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
Rider, the full $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you. Driver, no compensation is payable.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions in POL-NS-01 hold. Two do: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:12:35 (limb (a)), and the trip was terminated by the driver at 08:20:30 with reason code EXCESSIVE_WAIT and no boarding event (limb (d)). Limbs (b) and (c) fail, and breaking any one limb is enough.

Limb (b) - arrival inside the geofence (POL-NS-02). Only fixes reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better may be used, and worse fixes count as evidence of neither presence nor absence. On this STANDARD pickup (50 m radius) the driver's trace returns 0 qualifying in-radius fixes out of 93. The nearest raw reading, 37.9 m, would sit inside 50 m on its face, but it - like every other driver fix, and like the rider's 60 fixes - fails the 25 m filter. POL-NS-02's rule is explicit: where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation, the driver has not arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund. The filter removes the arrival proof; it does not turn into proof that the driver was elsewhere, and it is not a finding against him, but the arrival test is not met. The rider's track (60 fixes, single speed 0.0, max 40.4 m) is neutral in the same way and is not read against her.

Limb (c) and POL-NS-06 - dwell. Independently, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (longest qualifying run 0, run_count 0, shortfall 300). POL-NS-01(c) runs the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, so the trip record's 7.9-minute wait_time_min is not the policy dwell - it is the marker-to-cancel interval, and it does not support the charge. The separate-interval summing in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: it requires a present and populated traffic advisory, and EV-ADVIS-00212-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) - a missing advisory makes the limb unavailable rather than excusing anyone, and it could never have reduced the required minimum. The shortfall stands at the full 300 seconds.

WRONG-ENTRANCE (POL-NS-03). This does not change the money: the fee is refunded in full whether the driver is treated as never having arrived (POL-NS-02) or as having waited at the wrong face of the pickup (POL-NS-03). On fault, the rider named 'exit A' in chat at 08:15:02 and Exit A is the single registered pickup point, so POL-NS-03(i) would place the loss on the driver and pay nothing. The pin-ambiguity goodwill in POL-NS-03(ii) is unavailable because registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more.

CONTACT CLAUSE (POL-NS-04). It does not apply: the driver replied 28 seconds after the rider's locating message, inside the 120-second window, so the clause is out regardless of what the reply said. Both sides agree on this and it decides nothing.

DRIVER COMPENSATION (POL-NS-07). The 80 percent payment is owed only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not, so nothing flows to the driver. The anti-farming check is not the reason - 2 no-show terminations against 132 completed trips (1.5 percent) is below both of the clause's limbs - but the clause is never reached. The alternative claim for SGD 3.20 therefore fails.

THE MONEY (POL-NS-08 / POL-GEN-03). EV-FARE-00212 shows a cancellation_fee of 4.00, the greater of the STANDARD zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, with every other line at zero and no refund yet issued. No POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect arises, and the refund restores that line in full.

ESCALATION (POL-NS-09). Escalation is not warranted. The only apparent conflict - a trip record asserting an arrival and a 7.9-minute hold against a trace with zero in-geofence dwell - is resolved by POL-NS-01(c)'s rule for measuring dwell, so POL-NS-09(b) is not engaged. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): there is no clock skew (the arrived event sits within a 10 s fix and the cancellation time matches the last fix), no sampling gap over 120 s and 93 fixes across the window, the chat log matches its own message count and sequencing, and the fare reconciles. POL-NS-09(e) therefore does not fire. Neither profile carries the counters POL-NS-09(c) or (d) read (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; no_show_disputes_30d is 0). And the deciding fact is carried by EV-GPS-00212 at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not approached. Holding the fee for a reviewer would leave the rider funding a charge the policy does not permit.

FALSE-ARRIVAL REFERRAL (POL-NS-05). No referral is recorded. POL-NS-05 turns on the driver's distance or speed at the arrival timestamp, and the trace discloses no fix at 08:12:35, so the false-marker test cannot be run and POL-NS-05(ii)'s referral is not produced. That the trace covers 3.2 km at speeds up to 43.5 km/h is a reason to doubt the account of a parked car, but it is not the test the clause states.

DRIVER'S STATEMENT. Your explanation was read and weighed as evidence. It is a later account, not a contemporaneous record, and it meets no limb whose clause names a counterparty statement, so it does not displace the trace.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding fact is carried by EV-GPS-00212 at weight 1.0, capping confidence at 1.0; I set it at 0.9.
